annotation.codec: SHA-256 over the fully framed domain-separated preimage: u8 len||domainTag, u8 len||levelId, u8 len||levelVersion (RAW 32 bytes, not hexadecimal display text), u8 len||languageId, u8 len||languageVersion, u32be len||payload. Unframed concatenation is FORBIDDEN.

payloadEncoding.L0-verbatim: u32be raw_byte_len || exact snapshot body-span bytes; tokenisation forbidden

annotation.join: the frame is retained under the 64-hex suffix, so SHA-256(retained frame) equals it; the closure parses the frame and requires domainTag, levelId == normalisationLevel, levelVersion == the RAW 32 digest bytes of normalisationVersion, languageId from the fact sourceUniverse domain row, languageVersion == the RAW 32 digest bytes of the recomputed body-language-version projection, and at L0-verbatim the payload equals the enclosing fact anchor span bytes
